title: Rav Acha of Parzikya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Yevamot 59b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.59b.8) according to the Rosh’s reading, and in [Tosafot on Temurah 30b, s.v. Mana](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_on_Temurah.30b.1.1), asking Rav Ashi, “What is the source for the Rabbis’ statement that there is no harlotry for an animal?” Hyman gives Rava of Parkin as the reading of the Gemara.[^1]

notes.text: The [Rosh on Yevamot 6:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_on_Yevamot.6.6.2) reads Rav Acha מפרזקיה. Tosafot gives Rav Acha with two spellings of the place. Davidson’s Yevamot has Rava of Parzikya in Hebrew and Rava of Pirkin in English. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3184&lang=en) compares related forms and offers a tentative identification.
